stage: Stage 3 - Custom CUDA Bottleneck Deep-Dive Investigation

axis_1_cublaslt_bias_epilogue.architectural_reason: cuBLASLt incorporates bias addition directly into the GEMM register tile accumulator, avoiding an extra DRAM read-modify-write cycle.

axis_2_global_memory_traffic.memory_traffic_penalty: Intermediate matrix must be committed to DRAM/L2 cache by torch.matmul before custom CUDA elementwise kernel can consume it.

axis_4_python_autograd_dispatch.cause: Python C-API frame allocation, torch.autograd.Function.apply context creation, and backward hook dispatch.

axis_5_tensor_reshaping.stride_status: Contiguous (no data copying, purely metadata/stride manipulation in PyTorch TensorImpl).

axis_6_kernel_launch_overhead.impact: Negligible on end-to-end latency (< 5 us per kernel), well pipelined in CUDA hardware command queues.

backward_column_reduce_kernel.architectural_finding: The column_reduce_bias_kernel launches only 12 blocks for N=3072 columns. On a 20-SM Ampere GPU, 8 SMs sit completely idle (40% hardware underutilization during bias gradient reduction).

axis_8_memory_bandwidth_utilization.verdict: Custom CUDA kernels achieve 70-80% of theoretical DRAM saturation, indicating high memory controller efficiency, but are limited by DRAM bus bandwidth.

axis_9_tensor_core_vs_cuda_core.computation_regime: cuBLASLt GEMM is compute/Tensor Core bound (high arithmetic intensity); custom fused bias+activation is memory bandwidth bound (low arithmetic intensity).

root_cause_hierarchy: 1. cuBLASLt Epilogue Bias Fusion: PyTorch F.linear fuses bias addition directly into the GEMM register tile, saving an entire DRAM write/read pass.
2. Python Autograd Dispatch Boundary: PyTorch C++ ATen invokes native kernels without Python interpreter overhead; Custom CUDA incurs ~0.04 ms per layer through torch.autograd.Function.apply.
3. Column Reduction SM Underoccupancy: column_reduce_bias_kernel launches only 12 thread blocks across 20 SMs, leaving 40% of the GPU hardware SMs completely idle during bias gradient computation.

4. Lack of Vectorized 128-bit Loads in fused_bias_activation_fp16: Unlike the standalone gelu_fp16_kernel_vec8, the fused kernel operates on scalar half elements with a 16x16 2D block rather than vectorized float4/Half8Vec.

optimization_roadmap_candidates.risk: Requires column dimension alignment to 8 half elements (3072 is multiple of 8, so safe).

optimization_roadmap_candidates.risk: Requires two-pass reduction or atomic accumulation to utilize all 20 SMs.
